newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Oct trade surplus widens to $21.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Oct trade surplus widens to $21.1 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $21.1 billion in the first ten months of this year after a $20.1 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Sunday.
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Oct 96 Jan-Sep 96 Jan-Oct 95

NOTES: Figures in billion dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with Russia's "far abroad" excluding former Soviet states. Including trade with former Soviet republics, the surplus widened to $20.3 billion from $17.8 billion a year ago.
